text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Those newly arrived "Super Ultra-Heavy 
Horseshoes"... Why does everyone hesitate 
to use them? I simply cannot comprehend 
it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It certainly puts a high strain on the 
knees, but it trains your hindquarters 
well in return. In the end, muscle 
training is the best way to win.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to attain victory, you must 
take bold measures. I shall make full use 
of it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Though, whenever I use it, it somehow 
wears out surprisingly fast. I wonder 
why... Fufufu.
